topofix-257-rethink.title: XCU 257 alias patch-back: how to rethink
topofix-257-rethink.lead: The final repair round failed on four blockers; the Owner rule forbids a third round. Choose the direction for a new step.

options.body: Write invariants first (owner-group all-pairs within 0.001 mm, reader-shared attribute semantics, child-record distinctness, allow-list from real CAESAR II files including Owner files), IR invariant review, then a new step gated by the Oracle local suite.
